title: Penniston given sodium pentothal in interrogation
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Penniston given sodium pentothal in interrogation, about 1980-1981 at RAF Bentwaters, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jim penison said that he was subjected to like sodium penthol some kind of drug was administered to him he was questioned

plain: A researcher named Robert Hastings, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about UFOs seen near nuclear bases, passes on what a man named Jim Penniston told him. Penniston was linked to sightings around 1980 near RAF Bentwaters, a base in England (RAF stands for Britain's Royal Air Force). According to Hastings, Penniston said that afterward he was given a drug, something like sodium pentothal, and questioned, which would mean officials worked hard to control what he remembered.
